disclaimer.zh: 滑雪教练经验估分，非 FIS 裁判分，非医疗建议。2D 骨骼会误判。疼痛或旧伤请线下教练/医师。
disclaimer.en: Coach heuristics, not FIS judging or medical advice. 2D pose can misread. Pain or prior injury: see a coach or clinician.

desc.zh: 建议绿道；坡度未经实测。
desc.en: Suggested green run; slope is not measured.

desc.zh: 建议蓝道；坡度未经实测。
desc.en: Suggested blue run; slope is not measured.

desc.zh: 建议红道；坡度未经实测。
desc.en: Suggested red run; slope is not measured.

desc.zh: 建议黑道；坡度未经实测。
desc.en: Suggested black run; slope is not measured.

desc.zh: 公园建议场地，本 App 不评空中。
desc.en: Suggested park terrain; this app does not score air.

desc.zh: 雪包场地建议，非包型实测。
desc.en: Suggested mogul field; bump shape is not measured.

desc.zh: 建议雪场界内的野雪区域；雪深不做测量。
desc.en: Suggested off-piste inside the resort boundary; snow depth is not measured.

desc.zh: 本阶段不指定地形；在你已经滑得好的雪道上练。
desc.en: No terrain suggestion at this stage; use the runs you already ski well.

desc.zh: 安静缓坡绿道——先掌握犁式制动。
desc.en: Quiet, easy green run — master the wedge stop first.

tips.zh: 选最缓的坡，避开冰面和拥挤出口。
tips.en: Pick the gentlest pitch; avoid ice and crowded runouts.

desc.zh: 中等平整蓝道；适合平行、搓雪与大弯刻滑。
desc.en: Moderate groomed blue run; for parallel, skids, and long-radius carve.

tips.zh: 人少、雪软一点更好；冰面减小弯深。
tips.en: Prefer fewer people and softer snow; shallower turns on ice.

desc.zh: 更陡的平整红道；适合中小弯刻滑经验课。
desc.en: Steeper groomed red run; for medium and short carve heuristics.

tips.zh: 先在蓝道练内倾再上红道；动作变形时降到更缓的坡。
tips.en: Practice inclination on blue before moving to red; drop to an easier pitch when form fades.

desc.zh: 仅在雪包落差线课使用的陡/难建议，仍非实测。
desc.en: Steep/hard suggestion for fall-line moguls only; still not measured.

tips.zh: 包圆、线空、能看到沟；不要为了黑道硬上。
tips.en: Round bumps, an open line, visible troughs; do not force a black run.

desc.zh: 圆而浅的包，先直滑吸收。
desc.en: Round, shallow bumps; absorb in a straight line first.

tips.zh: 避开尖包、跳台和过窄的线。
tips.en: Avoid sharp bumps, jumps, and a too-narrow line.

desc.zh: 仅目录展示：箱、杆、跳台需教练指导；本 App 不评分。
desc.en: Display only: boxes, rails, and jumps with a coach; the app does not score them.

tips.zh: 只在有教练、戴头盔且受监管的公园尝试箱、杆或跳台。
tips.en: Only try boxes, rails, or jumps with a coach, a helmet, and a supervised park.

desc.zh: 紧邻雪道的未压雪松软雪面；不要越出雪场界。
desc.en: Soft, ungroomed snow just off a marked run; stay inside the resort boundary.

tips.zh: 不要独自滑野雪；避开雪崩地形与界外区域，始终与同伴保持在视线内。
tips.en: Never ski off-piste alone; avoid avalanche terrain and sidecountry, and keep a partner in sight.

desc.zh: 室内或平地，练站姿和单腿力量。
desc.en: Indoors or flat ground for stance and single-leg strength.

tips.zh: 防滑地面，旁边有扶手更好。
tips.en: Non-slip floor; a handhold nearby helps.

desc.zh: 画面稳、一人、侧或斜后，才能判定阶段。
desc.en: Stable follow-cam, one skier, side or rear-quarter.

training.zh: 跟拍手机，画面尽量只框一名双板滑者。
training.en: Follow-cam; one alpine skier in frame.

training.zh: 从侧面或斜后方拍完整段，少遮挡、光线足够。
training.en: Side or rear-quarter, whole run, little occlusion.

training.zh: 保持镜头稳定——剧烈晃动会导致阶段无法可靠判定。
training.en: Keep the camera steady — shaky or wild motion prevents a reliable stage assessment.

desc.zh: 踝膝髋微屈，重心在脚心，不后坐。
desc.en: Soft ankles, knees, and hips; center of mass over mid-foot.

training.zh: 标准：侧面看髋在踝上方，膝不锁死。
training.en: Standard: hip over ankle in profile; knees unlocked.

training.zh: 3 组 × 30 秒，不许塌腰后坐。
training.en: 3×30s; no collapsed backseat.

desc.zh: 练单腿力量，为半犁收板与刻滑外侧承重做准备。
desc.en: Single-leg strength for the christie close and carve outside ski.

training.zh: 标准：膝沿脚尖，骨盆不左右倾倒。
training.en: Standard: knees track over the toes; pelvis level.

training.zh: 双腿深蹲 3×8；保加利亚分腿蹲每侧 3×6。
training.en: 3×8 squats; Bulgarian split squat 3×6 each side.

desc.zh: 推开板尾并立刃急停；不要一屁股坐下。
desc.en: Open the tails and edge to a stop; do not sit down.

training.zh: 标准：十次停下板头始终相对、上身对山下。
training.en: Standard: ten stops, tips close, torso facing downhill.

training.zh: 绿道犁式直滑，匀速后再推开板尾立刃停下。
training.en: Wedge-glide on a green run, then open the tails and edge to a stop.

desc.zh: 在仍能刹车的前提下划浅 C，外侧板承重。
desc.en: Shallow C-turns while the wedge still brakes; load the outside ski.

training.zh: 标准：连续 S 迹，不冲道边；弯中犁式不消失。
training.en: Standard: linked S-track, no dart to the edge; the wedge stays through the turn.

training.zh: 斜滑降开始，外侧加压划小 C，再换另一侧。
training.en: From a traverse, pressure the outside ski through a small C, then switch sides.

desc.zh: 用腿和髋改变板向，肩不要当方向盘。
desc.en: Legs and hips steer; do not use the shoulders as a steering wheel.

training.zh: 标准：板开始转时肩仍大体对山下。
training.en: Standard: the skis start to turn while the shoulders still face downhill.

training.zh: 陆上模拟：微屈站，左右髋内旋带动脚尖，肩不动。
training.en: On land: athletic stance, rotate the femurs to turn the toes, keep the shoulders still.

desc.zh: 入弯犁、出弯逐渐并板，禁止突然并死。
desc.en: Wedge to start, gradually match at the finish; do not snap shut.

training.zh: 标准：出弯后半段站距变小，但不失稳。
training.en: Standard: stance narrows in the last third of the turn, still stable.

training.zh: 绿/蓝道做 8 个弯，只在出弯后三分之一并内侧板。
training.en: Eight turns on green or blue; match the inside ski only in the last third of the turn.

desc.zh: 杖尖放低，手在身前约腰至胸中，给左右转弯节拍。
desc.en: Keep pole tips low and hands in front of the body, about waist to mid-torso, to time left–right turns.

training.zh: 标准：回放里手腕不高于肩。
training.en: Standard: on replay, the wrists stay below the shoulders.

training.zh: 缓坡平行或犁式，每弯轻点山下杖。
training.en: Easy slope, parallel or wedge: tap the downhill pole each turn.

desc.zh: 平行板急停；进入搓雪小弯前的必过刹车技能。
desc.en: Parallel-ski emergency stop; required braking skill before short skidded turns.

training.zh: 标准：左右都能停在预定点，板平行、不犁开。
training.en: Standard: stop on a mark both ways; skis parallel, not in a wedge.

training.zh: 从缓坡斜滑降开始，双板同时横切并立刃停下。
training.en: From a gentle traverse, pivot both skis across the hill and set the edges to a stop.

training.zh: 每侧 8 次；速度一起来先回到斜滑再刹。
training.en: Eight each side; if speed builds, reset to a traverse before stopping.

desc.zh: 平行板快速左右转换控速，允许刃搓混合。
desc.en: Linked short skids on parallel skis; mixed edge and skid is acceptable.

training.zh: 标准：弯与弯之间没有长横切；膝有屈伸。
training.en: Standard: no long traverse between turns; knees flex and extend.

training.zh: 蓝道平整处 10 个短弯一组，肩静手低。
training.en: Ten short turns on a blue run; quiet shoulders, hands low.

desc.zh: 刻滑前先能把重量放在外侧板上。
desc.en: Balance on the outside ski before carving.

training.zh: 标准：缓坡外侧板滑一段，内侧板轻点雪不承重。
training.en: Standard: glide on the outside ski; the inside ski taps the snow without taking weight.

training.zh: 每侧 6 次斜滑降；失稳就放回双脚，不要硬撑。
training.en: Six traverses per side; put the ski down if you wobble.

desc.zh: 平行板内倾做圆顺大弯——教练经验估分，非竞速刻滑得分。
desc.en: Round, progressive long turns with parallel skis and inclination — coach heuristic, not a race carve score.

training.zh: 标准：髋向弯心倾，肩不甩；站距保持平行。
training.en: Standard: hips incline into the turn, shoulders quiet, stance parallel.

training.zh: 中等坡画 6 个大 C，外侧腿更长。
training.en: Six large C-turns on a moderate pitch; longer outside leg.

desc.zh: 在大弯能倾之后缩短半径。
desc.en: Shorten the radius only after long-radius inclination works.

training.zh: 标准：换刃点清楚，不直立横刮。
training.en: Standard: a clear edge change, not an upright scrape.

training.zh: 同一坡面 8 个中弯，频率高于大弯、低于小弯。
training.en: Eight medium turns on the same pitch; cadence between long and short.

desc.zh: 快换刃但平行与内倾不能丢。
desc.en: Faster edge changes without losing parallel inclination.

training.zh: 标准：左右对称，肩更静。
training.en: Standard: left-right symmetry, even quieter shoulders.

training.zh: 组数少、质量高，避免以疲劳换变形。
training.en: Few high-quality sets; do not train fatigue into poor form.

desc.zh: 包顶缩短腿、沟底伸长；腿贴雪，不要跳。
desc.en: Shorten the legs at the crest, lengthen in the trough; stay on snow, do not jump.

training.zh: 标准：上身相对静，膝屈振幅大，落地不砸直腿。
training.en: Standard: quiet torso, large knee travel, no straight-leg slam.

training.zh: 选圆而浅的包沿沟直滑 8 次。
training.en: Eight straight lines over round, shallow bumps.

desc.zh: 雪板横置向侧下方滑行，先向前再向后，上身始终朝向山下。
desc.en: Slip down and across, forward then back, with the torso facing downhill.

training.zh: 标准：雪板始终横向对坡，上身不跟着转。
training.en: Standard: the skis stay across the hill and the torso does not turn with them.

training.zh: 在初级道上横向站好，放平两只板开始侧滑，再立刃停住；每侧十次。
training.en: On a green run, stand across the hill, flatten both skis to slip, then edge to stop; ten repeats each way.

desc.zh: 换刃时伸展，走弧线时蹲屈；出声数节奏。
desc.en: Extend into the new turn and flex through the arc; count the rhythm out loud.

training.zh: 标准：每个转弯数同样的拍子，最深的蹲屈落在弧线中段。
training.en: Standard: the same count on every turn, with the deepest flexion in the middle of the arc.

training.zh: 在中级道上做十个连贯的平行式转弯，每个转弯数“一—二”。
training.en: Ten linked parallel turns on a blue run, counting one-two through every turn.

desc.zh: 在过落差线之前就立好刃，让雪板先咬住雪面再指向坡下。
desc.en: Set the edge above the fall line so the ski grips before it points down the hill.

training.zh: 标准：硬雪上留下细窄干净的刻痕，板尾不搓花。
training.en: Standard: a clean, narrow track on hardpack with no scraped-out tail.

training.zh: 在硬实的中级压雪道上做六个大弧转弯；只有刻痕干净时才缩小半径。
training.en: Six long turns on firm blue groomers; shorten the radius only while the track stays clean.

desc.zh: 在安静的上身下方把两只板转过来，短距离侧滑后再转回去。
desc.en: Pivot both skis under a quiet upper body, slip a short distance, then pivot back.

training.zh: 标准：每次转板时肩线始终朝向坡下。
training.en: Standard: the shoulders keep facing down the pitch through every pivot.

training.zh: 在一小段陡坡上做八次转板侧滑；只有上身保持安静后再连成小回转。
training.en: On a short steep section, pivot-slip eight times; link short turns only once the upper body stays quiet.

desc.zh: 在松软雪中两只板一起上下起伏，感受雪面的回弹。
desc.en: Bounce both skis together in soft snow to feel the snow push back.

training.zh: 标准：两只板同时浮出雪面，不出现单板下沉。
training.en: Standard: both skis surface together; no single-ski dive.

training.zh: 在松软坡面上直滑并起伏六次，再把起伏连成转弯。
training.en: Straight-run a soft slope and bounce six times, then link the bounces into turns.

desc.zh: 少横切，连续吸收，仍不开空中评分。
desc.en: Fewer traverses, linked absorption; still no air scoring.

training.zh: 标准：髋大致沿落差线，少横切；仍由膝屈伸做功。
training.en: Standard: hips stay near the fall line; the knees still do the work.

training.zh: 八到十二个包一组，累了就停。
training.en: Sets of 8–12 bumps; stop when form fades.

desc.zh: 板头近、板尾开，站距宽于髋。
desc.en: Tips close, tails open, stance wider than the hips.

desc.zh: 膝踝有弹性，不锁直。
desc.en: Elastic knees and ankles; not locked.

desc.zh: 髋在脚上方，压力送到板刃。
desc.en: Hips over the feet; pressure into the ski.

desc.zh: 膝沿脚尖方向；不要让膝盖向内塌。
desc.en: Knees track over the toes; don't let the knees collapse inward.

desc.zh: 转弯中仍保持犁式，外侧承重。
desc.en: Stay in a wedge through the turn; load the outside ski.

desc.zh: 经验提示：用腿转向——髋内旋带动板头转向，上身保持安静。
desc.en: Heuristic: steer with the legs — rotate the femurs so the ski tips turn while the torso stays quiet.

desc.zh: 入弯略降重心，膝有弹性。
desc.en: Slightly lower in the turn; elastic knees.

desc.zh: 有左右转向，不是一条直线冲坡。
desc.en: Left-right turns, not a straight schuss.

desc.zh: 肩不要跟着板狂转。
desc.en: Do not spin the shoulders with the skis.

desc.zh: 2D 头关键点不可靠则不计分。
desc.en: Unscored when the head is not visible in 2D pose.

desc.zh: 站距有开合，不是全程死犁。
desc.en: Stance width varies; not a locked wedge the whole turn.

desc.zh: 平均站距介于大犁与平行之间。
desc.en: Mean stance between a full wedge and parallel.

desc.zh: 站距约髋宽；过宽说明犁式没收干净。
desc.en: About hip-width; wider usually means you're still in a wedge.

desc.zh: 腿动、上身相对安静。
desc.en: Legs move; the torso stays quieter.

desc.zh: 不后坐，才能把重量交给新的外侧板。
desc.en: Stay centered so you can move onto the new outside ski.

desc.zh: 展示能用平行板按指令急停（左右两侧）。
desc.en: Show you can stop on command with parallel skis (both directions).

desc.zh: 快速左右转换，不要长横切。
desc.en: Quick left-right; no long traverse.

desc.zh: 不要用锁死的直腿落地或缓冲。
desc.en: Don't land or absorb with locked, straight legs.

desc.zh: 手腕低于肩。
desc.en: Wrists below the shoulders.

desc.zh: 向弯心倾斜身体（髋在弧内）。仅为经验估分——非实测刃角或 FIS 得分。
desc.en: Tip the body into the turn (hips inside the arc). Heuristic only — not a measured edge angle or FIS score.

desc.zh: 站距保持平行，否则倾会变成内倒。
desc.en: Stay parallel or inclination becomes banking.

desc.zh: 甩肩会破坏内倾。
desc.en: Throwing the shoulders wrecks inclination.

desc.zh: 换刃快于大弯。
desc.en: Edge changes faster than long-radius.

desc.zh: 频率升高仍保持内倾。
desc.en: Higher cadence without losing inclination.

desc.zh: 膝屈振幅大，贴雪而不是跳。
desc.en: Large knee travel; stay on snow rather than jumping.

desc.zh: 让腿做功。
desc.en: Let the legs do the work.

desc.zh: 膝屈伸节奏与雪包合拍。
desc.en: Knee flex cadence matches the bumps.

desc.zh: 少横切，沿落差线连贯过包。
desc.en: Link bumps near the fall line with less traversing.

desc.zh: 把两只板放平向侧下方滑，再立刃停住——既不是锁死立刃，也不是失控下滑。
desc.en: Flatten both skis to slip sideways, then edge again to stop — neither a locked edge nor a free slide.

desc.zh: 雪板侧滑时，肩线始终正对落差线。
desc.en: The shoulders stay square to the fall line while the skis slip.

name.zh: 压力峰值出现在转弯中段
name.en: Pressure peaks in the shaping phase

desc.zh: 最深的蹲屈出现在弧线中段，而不是收弯处——不要立刃后干等。
desc.en: Deepest flexion in the middle of the arc, not at the finish — no park-and-ride.

desc.zh: 每次换刃轻点一次雪杖，双手保持在身前。
desc.en: A light pole touch at each edge change, hands kept in front.

desc.zh: 每个转弯的用时接近一致；转弯之间不夹长横切。
desc.en: Turn durations stay close to each other; no long traverse between turns.

name.en: Quick edge change on firm snow

desc.zh: 两侧立刃之间快速过渡；在硬雪上雪板一放平就会滑走。
desc.en: Cross from edge to edge quickly; a ski left flat slides away on hardpack.

desc.zh: 用转弯弧形控速，而不是把板尾横过落差线搓雪。
desc.en: Control speed with turn shape, not by scraping the tails across the fall line.

name.en: Upper body down the fall line

desc.zh: 双腿在身体下方转弯，肩线始终朝向坡下。
desc.en: The shoulders keep facing down the pitch while the legs turn underneath.

name.zh: 用转弯而不是横滑下坡
name.en: Turn instead of side-slipping the pitch

desc.zh: 多数转弯要走出弧形；偶尔侧滑找回节奏可以，一路横滑下坡不行。
desc.en: Most turns finish with a shaped arc; a slip to recover is fine, a slipped descent is not.

name.en: Flex and extend to surface the skis

desc.zh: 每个转弯都有明显的上下起伏；站姿僵直会让板头下沉。
desc.en: Clear up-and-down movement in every turn; a static stance sinks the tips.

desc.zh: 保持弧形圆顺、两只板一起工作；不要把雪板横甩出去。
desc.en: Keep the arc round with both skis working; do not throw the skis sideways.

desc.zh: 穿好装备，在平地上行走，滑出几米，摔倒后能自己站起来。
desc.en: Put the gear on, walk on the flat, glide a few metres, and get up after a fall.

note.zh: 这个年龄段站距偏宽是符合力学的，站距不作扣分。
note.en: A wide stance is mechanically correct at this age; stance width is not penalized.

note.zh: 这个年龄段站距偏宽是符合力学的，站距不作扣分。
note.en: A wide stance is mechanically correct at this age; stance width is not penalized.

desc.zh: 用犁式板形直线下山并主动停下。
desc.en: Glide straight in a wedge and stop on purpose.

note.zh: 这个年龄段站距偏宽是符合力学的，站距不作扣分。
note.en: A wide stance is mechanically correct at this age; stance width is not penalized.

note.zh: 这个年龄段站距偏宽是符合力学的，站距不作扣分。
note.en: A wide stance is mechanically correct at this age; stance width is not penalized.

desc.zh: 浅弧 C 弯，髋内旋导向，弯中保持犁。
desc.en: Shallow C-turns; hip internal rotation steers; the wedge stays.

note.zh: 这个年龄段站距偏宽是符合力学的，站距不作扣分。
note.en: A wide stance is mechanically correct at this age; stance width is not penalized.

note.zh: 这个年龄段站距偏宽是符合力学的，站距不作扣分。
note.en: A wide stance is mechanically correct at this age; stance width is not penalized.

desc.zh: 以犁式或半犁在雪包地形中保持节奏，吸收冲击。从犁式转弯直接进入雪包训练的早期入口。
desc.en: Navigate mogul terrain with wedge or semi-parallel; absorb bumps and stay rhythmic. Early entry into mogul skiing after wedge turns.

desc.zh: 同时放平两只板的立刃，向侧下方侧滑，再立刃停住；上身始终朝向山下。
desc.en: Release both edges to slip sideways, then re-set them to stop; the torso keeps facing downhill.

desc.zh: 入弯犁、出弯收内侧板。
desc.en: Wedge to start, close the inside ski to finish.

desc.zh: 双板平行，上下分离。过关后可选搓雪或刻滑大弯。
desc.en: Matched skis and separation. After passing, choose short skids or long-radius carve.

name.zh: 动态平行式：节奏与用杖

desc.zh: 连贯的平行式转弯：节奏均匀、蹲伸配合，每次换刃点一次雪杖。
desc.en: Linked parallel turns with an even rhythm, a flex-and-extend move, and a pole touch at every edge change.

desc.zh: 在硬雪或冰面上保持干净的立刃：提早立刃、换刃迅速、不靠搓雪刹车。
desc.en: Hold a clean edge on hardpack: edge early, change edges quickly, no braking scrape.

desc.zh: 短半径搓雪控速；必须掌握冰球刹。过关可进雪包。
desc.en: Short-radius skids for speed control; hockey stop required. Then moguls.

desc.zh: 经验估分内倾与平行，非 FIS。最好先掌握单脚滑。
desc.en: Heuristic inclination and parallel stance, not FIS. Learn one-ski first.

note.zh: 刻滑需要一定体重才能把雪板压弯；13 岁以下不适用。
note.en: Carving needs body mass to bend the ski; not applicable below age 13.

note.zh: 刻滑需要一定体重才能把雪板压弯；13 岁以下不适用。
note.en: Carving needs body mass to bend the ski; not applicable below age 13.

desc.zh: 在大弯能倾之后缩短半径。
desc.en: Shorten the radius only after long-radius inclination works.

note.zh: 刻滑需要一定体重才能把雪板压弯；13 岁以下不适用。
note.en: Carving needs body mass to bend the ski; not applicable below age 13.

note.zh: 刻滑需要一定体重才能把雪板压弯；13 岁以下不适用。
note.en: Carving needs body mass to bend the ski; not applicable below age 13.

desc.zh: 快换刃，肩更静。平整道刻滑枝终点。
desc.en: Fast edge change, quieter shoulders. End of the groomed carve branch.

note.zh: 刻滑需要一定体重才能把雪板压弯；13 岁以下不适用。
note.en: Carving needs body mass to bend the ski; not applicable below age 13.

note.zh: 刻滑需要一定体重才能把雪板压弯；13 岁以下不适用。
note.en: Carving needs body mass to bend the ski; not applicable below age 13.

desc.zh: 陡坡上的小回转：上身朝向落差线，用转弯弧形控速。
desc.en: Short turns on a steep pitch: the upper body faces down the fall line and turn shape controls the speed.

desc.zh: 从犁式雪包或搓雪枝进入：主动吸收贴雪，保持节奏，不要跳。
desc.en: From wedge mogul or skid branch: absorb actively, stay on snow, do not jump.

desc.zh: 少横切的连续吸收。不评空中。
desc.en: Linked absorption near the fall line. No air score.

desc.zh: 在松软雪中双脚均匀受力、转弯更圆；靠蹲伸让雪板浮起来。
desc.en: Two-footed, rounder turns in soft snow; flex and extend to make the skis surface.

desc.zh: 在烂雪、被翻过的雪面和林间稀疏树区里读地形、选线路。仅限雪场界内。
desc.en: Read the terrain and pick a line in crud, cut-up snow and gladed trees. Inside the resort boundary only.

desc.zh: 选定一个方向，拍摄自己的滑行，建立自己的训练循环。
desc.en: Pick a branch, film your own skiing, and run your own practice cycle.

desc.zh: 仅目录展示：2D 骨骼不评空中与板尖。请线下教练。
desc.en: Display only: 2D pose does not score air or ski tips. Train with a coach.

desc.zh: 仅目录展示：箱、杆、跳台不自动打分。
desc.en: Display only: boxes, rails, and jumps are not scored.

desc.zh: 仅目录展示：本 App 不做旗门计时。
desc.en: Display only: this app does not time gates.

desc.zh: 仅目录展示：v2 视频不自动判定倒滑。
desc.en: Display only: v2 video does not classify switch.
